name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 10
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.10
source:
Five days after the grand tournament, Akira took his finals at school and then got back the virtual world where he met with Seraia for a group battle. The rules were groups of three but Seraia had invited an extra participant. However, on the day of the fight, that extra person ditched them for the opposite team.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE148840.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
大赛结束五天后，阿基拉在学校参加了决赛，然后回到虚拟世界，与塞拉亚进行了一场群战。规则是三人一组，但塞拉亚邀请了一名额外的参与者。然而，在战斗当天，那个额外的人却将他们抛弃到了对方队伍中。
